page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c7a.8xlarge is a compute-optimized virtual server instance built on the KVM hypervisor and powered by an AMD EPYC 7T83 processor. Operating on the x86_64 architecture at 2.55 GHz, this instance features 16 physical cores providing 32 dedicated vCPUs via simultaneous multithreading. It is equipped with 64 GB of memory, establishing a 1:2 vCPU-to-memory ratio of 2.0 GB per vCPU. Hardware features include 32 MB of L3 cache, AVX instruction set support, and hardware-accelerated AES encryption. Baseline network bandwidth is rated at 8 Gbps, while local disk storage and discrete GPUs are absent.

Performance evaluation reveals strong single-core CPU throughput in stress-ng tests alongside a high PassMark memory score. In small model LLM inference tasks, text generation speed ranks in the upper quartile at 287.51 tokens per second. Multi-core compute performance, Geekbench suites, Redis SET operations, and static web serving throughput align within middle-tier benchmark brackets. However, memory write bandwidth across large uncached 256 MB blocks shows lower efficiency at 18.87 GB/sec, highlighting a potential bottleneck for write-heavy memory workloads.

Positioned as a dedicated compute node, the resource allocation profile offers cost efficiency for compute-dense workloads that do not require high memory-per-core density or attached local NVMe drives. Relying on remote block storage and balanced networking, it serves tasks such as software compilation, batch processing, small-scale LLM text generation, web application backends, and moderate database services.
